applicants: Casting, Forging and Machining Cluster of South Africa NPC
ruling: NERSA ordered to redetermine 2024/25 electricity tariffs. Court declared NERSA approval unlawful and invalid.
implication_for_billdog: 2024/25 CoJ/City Power electricity tariffs are under legal challenge. Any 2024/25 CoJ electricity charge verifications should return UNKNOWN until redetermination is published. Do NOT generate disputes on CoJ 2024/25 electricity.
